name: Bhuta Natha Sadananda
text:
Bhutanatha Sadananda Sarva Bhuta Daya Para,
Raksha Raksha Mahabhago, Shastre Tubhyam Namo Namaha.
meaning: O Lord of all beings, ever blissful, compassionate to every being: protect us, protect us, great and blessed one. To you, Shasta, salutations again and again.
note: This is the verse of Ayyappa (Shasta): “Shastre tubhyam” means “to you, Shasta”. Sarvakali keeps it among Shiva’s mantras and chants it on Mondays. Her wording reads “Mahabhago” where some print “Mahabaho”; it is kept as she gives it.
source: The Ayyappa (Shasta) verse, as Sarvakali chants it
pronunciation: bhoo-ta-naa-tha sa-daa-nan-da sar-va bhoo-ta da-yaa pa-ra; rak-sha rak-sha ma-haa-bhaa-go, shaas-tray tub-hyam na-mo na-ma-ha
